summary: 3D Systems filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity program, offering up to $42.5 million of common stock through Cantor Fitzgerald as sales agent or principal under a Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement dated November 5, 2026. Shares trade on the NYSE as DDD; last reported price was $2.64 on November 4, 2026. The agent earns up to a 3.0% commission on gross sales, with no escrow arrangement. Sales occur at prevailing market prices, in block trades, or privately negotiated transactions. This is a routine shelf takedown rather than a special situation; watch dilution pace and any acceleration in selling pressure.
